living_room.caption: I guess references the landscape to. We worked with man-made veneers, which are responsibly made and renewable resources. The paints are all over the O.C., so good for our environment. When selecting veneers, there's always a consideration to the longevity of the material. We're using a lot of natural materials, but also within the taps and the wells.

balcony.caption: ventilation which when you're on the beach you've got those wonderful sea breezes on those hot days you can open up both sides of the apartment and get that natural ventilation. We've got these generous deep balconies with glass balustrades. They've got shelter they've got protection but they also open up and focus your view onto the beach and to the baby aunt. These concrete shrouds give you that sense that you are in your own apartment and you've got your own private view and I think that's one of the real success stories of the design.

kitchen.caption: in the kitchen, the honed and textured granite, which is not only hearty and practical.
